summary: The phone app's built-in fabric target is the member that uses the device's own pairing again, so a paired phone dials it

replay.detail: No claim replay or recovery behavior changes.

schema.detail: No tables, indexes, schema-version changes or data rewrites; the saved member list format is unchanged.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rules or digest changes.

compatibility.detail: Phone app only. A build that carries a default fabric target opens with it marked as using the device's pairing, as it did before the ordered member list; saved lists are untouched.

manual.detail: No operator action or re-pairing; a phone already paired keeps its pairing. A new build has to be installed on the phone.
